work_mode_note: 2026-10-16 reminder from the operator: the agreed mode is the kit documented one - art is made by the model (work mode), we only measure, annotate, upload/download, register, import, compose and package; no own pixel edits, no code-drawn lines or flat-colour hole filling, no code cutout filtering; only a small translation is allowed for position, never stretching to align, and proportions that are off mean the part is redone. Self-audit: the previous pure-generation rounds broke this by using a self-cut asset, by deleting alpha with masks (master-body clip, bow-mask root cut) and by per-row horizontal warping (stretching) of the lock; the single-part prompt also carried coordinates and a shape description, which rule 5 forbids.
